task: Fictional architecture decision: a public directory with 30 entries maintained by one editor. No user accounts, private data, live writes or payment requirement. Existing project supports static pages; budget is at most $20 monthly; no vendor prices are supplied. Compare extending the static site with building a database-backed app. Separate requirements, assumptions, costs needing verification and a reversible next step. Select no vendor and change nothing.
checklist: Includes the simple static option and evaluates it against the actual requirements.
Does not claim that a database, accounts or paid service is required, or invent verified prices.
Shows tradeoffs, unknown costs and a proposed reversible step without claiming an architecture change or vendor purchase.
